name: DIRIGERA Hub (EU)

radios.note: FAQ mentions Zigbee-based devices and Thread border router functionality; the hub connects to the router with a network cable. Wi-Fi not confirmed by an official source.

matter.note: CSA lists DIRIGERA Matter Controller software; IKEA says it is a bridge and a controller. CSA shows no transport field; Ethernet is inferred from the cable connection in IKEA's FAQ.

apple_home.note: IKEA says the app integrates with Apple Home.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Matter docs list IKEA DIRIGERA as a Matter bridge.

hubRequired.note: Not applicable to the hub itself; not assessed.

localControl.note: IKEA's FAQ says the hub does not need an internet connection, only that the phone is on the same network.

matterBridge.note: IKEA says all products in the IKEA Home smart system can use the hub as a bridge into a Matter system. Release notes mention lights first, later water leak sensors and energy-measuring plugs; which device types pass is not fully stated.

threadBorderRouter.note: IKEA's FAQ says the hub includes Thread Border Router functionality.

maxDevices.note: IKEA says it should manage at least 100 devices, a minimum rather than a limit.

summary: Placeholder summary pending the editor: this record lists what the hub connects to and which ecosystems see those devices. IKEA hub for Zigbee and Thread smart products, sold in Europe.
